_note: Starter lists for the community word filter (C1). Somay owns these lists; extend them any time, including Hinglish (P15), then run: node shared/sync.mjs. Entries are matched as whole words or whole phrases after normalising case, accents, leetspeak, zero-width characters, stretched letters and spaced-out letters. block: the post is refused and the writer keeps their text. review: the post goes up and lands in the admin review queue. allow: words that must never match.
